title: Source takeovers
description: Manage primary-to-fallback source takeovers per match and data group. Takeovers collect supplier candidates and never directly update canonical match data.

help.reasonCode: Use a stable lowercase code such as primary_timeout.
help.activation: Only scores and match status currently support real fallback collection. Other groups may be proposed but cannot be activated.
help.recovery: The primary must succeed at least 3 consecutive times over at least 2 minutes before reconciliation.
help.close: The server compares primary and fallback scores or status before closing. A mismatch never switches back.

messages.failed: Operation failed. Refresh and check the state, version, and server validation result.
messages.reasonRequired: An operation reason of at least 3 characters is required
